name: Sheet Pan Roasted Chicken & Veggies with Lemony Yogurt Dip
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest lemon into a small bowl, add yogurt, and whisk to combine. Set aside.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic. Add oil, honey, and spices; whisk to combine.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice the sweet potatoes into half rounds; add to the bowl.
Peel, trim, and cut the onion into thick wedges; add to the bowl.
Cut the chicken into small bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl with the veggies and toss to coat.

Transfer chicken and veggies to a large baking sheet pan and arrange in a single layer. Place in the oven and bake, tossing once, until the chicken is cooked through and veggies are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice the cucumber; place in a medium bowl along with the salt and pepper.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the cucumber and toss to combine.
To serve, divide chicken, roasted veggies, and cucumber salad between plates. Serve with lemon yogurt on the side for dipping. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
